_doc: What Works: what could stop it within a year of no input, and the safeguard for each. Test probes name a test in worker/*.test.mjs. Platform-wide faults (Actions outages, GitHub and Cloudflare incidents, Node end of life) are covered by doctrine/yearsim.json and apply to this Worker too.

risks.what: Workers AI retires the model that reads abstracts
risks.safeguard: models come from doctrine/models.json fallback_order; each failure falls through to the next; with none, leads wait unread and the curated grade stands
risks.probe: test:a model that fails falls through to the next, and the daily AI cap holds

risks.what: a model labels a study wrongly or invents a finding
risks.safeguard: design and direction each need a quote copied word for word from the abstract, the design quote must name the design, the finding shown is the source's own sentence, and read-in trials count at half weight
risks.probe: test:the reader guard accepts only labels backed by verbatim quotes that name the design

risks.what: OpenAlex or Europe PMC stops answering or changes its API
risks.safeguard: two independent indexes; a programme counts as checked when either answers; failures are logged and the programme is picked first next beat; freshness answers 503 when any programme is older than 7 days
risks.probe: test:a search failure is logged and retried: the programme is picked first next time, and freshness reports it

risks.what: a verdict changes with no record
risks.safeguard: every change of verdict or strength is a grade_changes row with the study that moved it, served at /changes and /feed.json
risks.probe: test:new evidence lands: found by search, read in under the guard, the grade moves up and the move names the study

risks.what: model calls grow past the budget
risks.safeguard: AI_DAILY_CAP (default 60 calls a day), 4 reads per beat; the account-wide spend governor still applies
risks.probe: test:a model that fails falls through to the next, and the daily AI cap holds

risks.safeguard: 300 taps per source per day by a daily one-way hash
risks.probe: test:a guess is counted anonymously, answered against the current grade, and capped per source

risks.safeguard: counters kept 30 days, beats 90 days; leads and grade changes are small and bounded by publication volume
a visit runs the beat when the last one is over 2 hours old; /health reports ticking, late or stopped
risks.probe: test:health reads the clock; a silent cron is caught up by the next visit; HALT stops writes but reading goes on

risks.safeguard: the Worker holds no secret; every index it reads is open
zero dependencies: plain Worker modules, node:sqlite only in tests
HALT stops the cron, catch-up beats and new writes; reads keep serving
risks.probe: test:health reads the clock; a silent cron is caught up by the next visit; HALT stops writes but reading goes on
